networks.claimBoundary: A report exists under Model/v7, but its internal version binding identifies v1. It is not published as a native V7-zero network.

Read-only validation metadata reports normalized V7/P33 embeddings in an existing V7 collection and explicitly reports no collection creation or point mutation by the validator. It is not a full V7 pipeline, general-quality, or first-index-time claim.

networks.displayName: Contextual Genius Network v7 - Frozen P37 Routing Contract
networks.claimBoundary: CGN is evidenced as a transparent routing component. 'Smaller' or 'close in size to CNS' is not claimed because comparable total parameter counts are unavailable.
This is a provider source contract in MCPServerMvc, not proof that a specific model weight file was loaded.

nodeGraph.basis: 19 node(s) derived from 19 actual-vector digest entrie(s); 19 node(s) bound to real EF write spans.
nodeGraph.runtimeContract: Offline repository-local deterministic 256-D runtime. For label L and dimension d: h = SHA256('cns-v7-p33-local-embed-v1\0' + L + '\0' + d); two little-endian UInt64 words of h drive a Box-Muller Gaussian sample; the 256 samples are L2-normalized to a unit vector. It is reproducible and content-dependent, and it is explicitly not the external trained CNS V7/P33 model weights.
nodeGraph.referenceNodeContract: The first node in ordinal order is the K_c_n_s living reference: it is the first actually-computed vector v0, fixed at (0,0,0). Every later node i publishes the canonical SHA-256 of vi, its 256-bit sign projection, and coordinates derived from the (vi - v0) difference digest, declaring referenceRelation='relative_to:K_c_n_s'.
nodeGraph.coordinateDerivation: Node 0 = (0,0,0). For index > 0: differenceDigest = SHA256(float32-LE canonical bytes of (vi - v0)); angle = 2*pi*u32le(differenceDigest[0..4])/2^32; radius = u32le(differenceDigest[4..8])/(2^32-1); x = radius*(1+cos(angle))/2; y = radius*(1+sin(angle))/2; z from accumulated sign-bit Hamming. Rounded to 12 decimals and reproducible from the published differenceCanonicalSha256.
nodeGraph.zAxisDerivation: z is derived only from the sign-bit Hamming axis: cumulativeDistanceBits(i) = sum of the 256-bit sign Hamming distances between consecutive vectors up to i, and z(i) = cumulativeDistanceBits(i) / (256*i), with z(0) = 0. It encodes accumulated sign-pattern separation of real vectors, not depth, importance, or semantics.

nodes.claimBoundary: Node identity is the canonical SHA-256 of a real, locally computed L2-normalized embedding vector; the sign projection is the per-dimension sign of that vector; coordinates are a reconstructable projection of the (vi - v0) difference digest and its accumulated sign-bit Hamming. No raw vector component, magnitude, model weight, activation, prompt, or user content is present, and none can be reconstructed from these fields.

coordinates.derivation: differenceDigest = SHA256(canonical float32-LE bytes of (vi - v0)); angle = 2*pi*u32le(differenceDigest[0..4])/2^32; radius = u32le(differenceDigest[4..8])/(2^32-1); x = radius*(1+cos(angle))/2; y = radius*(1+sin(angle))/2; z from accumulated sign-bit Hamming. Reconstructable from the published differenceCanonicalSha256 and sign projections.

hammingTransition.basis: Bit distance between the 256-bit sign projections of this vector and its predecessor. It measures sign-pattern separation of real vectors, not magnitude, activation, or semantic distance.

nodes.sourceBasis: Actual offline-computed L2-normalized 256-dimensional vector for label 'محامي' (Fixed CNS V7/P33 capture contract ordinal 17); identity is the canonical SHA-256 of the real vector bytes. Raw components are held only in the private local audit and SQLite artifact, never here.
nodes.claimBoundary: Node identity is the canonical SHA-256 of a real, locally computed L2-normalized embedding vector; the sign projection is the per-dimension sign of that vector; coordinates are a reconstructable projection of the (vi - v0) difference digest and its accumulated sign-bit Hamming. No raw vector component, magnitude, model weight, activation, prompt, or user content is present, and none can be reconstructed from these fields.
